sermon.title: Did Jesus Come To Israel Only? Will We See Signs and Wonders?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer uses maps of Israel to show Jesus ministering in Galilee and Syria, healing Gentiles like the Canaanite woman’s daughter. Isaiah 49:6 shows He was always a light to the nations. Many followed only for bread or chose religion over life. Signs and wonders come through preaching the gospel, not psychology or motivational talks.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What happened to the ten northern tribes?
faqs.answer: Assyria took them captive, though some were left in the land and some escaped down to Judah.

faqs.question: Was Jesus’ bloodline purely Jewish?
faqs.answer: No. Several Gentiles were brought into Judah’s line, because God never intended to leave the nations out.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But He answered and said, “I was not sent except to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

faqs.question: What did God tell Jesus in Isaiah 49:6?
faqs.answer: It is too small a thing only to restore the tribes of Jacob; He would also be a light to the Gentiles.
